reply.text: RPE 8 means you've got about 2 reps left in the tank when you stop. You could do 2 more, maybe 3, but you don't. It's a way to lift hard without grinding every set to absolute failure, which helps you recover better and do it again the next session. RPE is a scale from 1 to 10 — 10 is max effort, 1 is nothing — so an RPE 8 is solid work without leaving everything on the floor.
